reasoning.whyChosen: Provides a single lifecycle, policy, and cost-management boundary for the one production environment.
reasoning.tradeoffs: A single resource group intentionally matches the one-environment requirement; service-level identities and RBAC still isolate data access.

overallReasoning.summary: A single Canada Central production environment balances resilient data services, an always-ready authenticated dashboard, workload-specific managed identities, evidence lineage, relational querying, observability, and model governance. GitHub remains the read-only source; deterministic facts are authoritative; Foundry output is advisory.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: The first production release remains single-region and uses authenticated public service endpoints rather than private networking. Service Bus and multi-region failover remain future upgrades; ZRS storage and zone-redundant PostgreSQL address the most material current availability risks.

plan.validation: Every dependency resolves to a resource in this plan. No circular dependencies exist. Storage and Key Vault meet identity and recovery constraints. Canada Central supports ZRS storage and zone-redundant General Purpose PostgreSQL. Container Apps consumption requires no delegated VNet. Authentication, source OAuth, schedules, and model deployment remain gated until their secrets and quotas are verified.
